movelist.name: Psychic
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 1 meter in any direction. Psychic lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Pain Split
movelist.effect: The user and the target both lose ½ of their current Hit Points. Add the amount of Hit Points the user and the target lost together, and divide the value by 2. Both the target and the user gain Hit Points equal to this value.  Do not add Injuries from Pain Split from Hit Point Markers until the full effect of the Move has been resolved. Pain Split never causes Massive Damage. Hit Point loss from Pain Split cannot be prevented in any way

movelist.name: Future Sight
movelist.effect: Future Sight does nothing on the turn it is used. At the end of the user’s next turn, Future Sight hits, even if the user is no longer on the field. Future Sight cannot miss.

movelist.name: Endeavor
movelist.effect: The target loses a Tick of Hit Points for each Injury the user has.

movelist.name: Psyshock
movelist.effect: When calculating damage, the target subtracts their Defense from Psyshock’s damage instead of their Special Defense. Psyshock is still otherwise Special ( Special Evasion is used to avoid it, Mirror Coat can reflect it, etc. )

movelist.name: Recover
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value.

movelist.name: Charm
movelist.effect: Charm lowers the target’s Attack 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Light Screen
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Light Screen may activate it when receiving Special Damage to resist the Damage one step. Light Screen may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

abilities.name: Magic Guard
abilities.effect: The user is immune to damage and Hit Point loss from Hazards, Weather, Status Afflictions, Vortexes, Recoil, Hay Fever, Iron Barbs, Rough Skin, and Leech Seed. Defensive.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: The Pokémon resists Ground-Type Moves one step further, and gains a Levitate Speed of 4, or has existing Levitate Speeds increased by +2. Defensive.

abilities.name: Cluster Mind
abilities.effect: The user’s Move Pool limit is increased by +2.
